thread:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — embed-service 5xx rate spike in us-west-2 (p95 latency also elevated). Auto-escalation to oncall.
emily k: seeing this on the dashboard, switching to manual routing to canary model to reduce load. initiating mitigation now. /cc @raj p
raj p: on it. grabbing recent deploys and scaling groups. does anyone have a quick query for which customers saw errors? we should assess impact asap.
samuel g: quick grep in logs shows repeated error: `rpc: downstream connection reset by peer` around 20:22:10 - suspect transient upstream connection issues. past 10m error-rate ~ 12%% for embed-service.
miguel r: i pushed a temporary rate limit bump on the proxy (configs: `max_reqs_per_minute: 1200 -> 800`) + turned on KV cache bypass for susceptible paths. will monitor.
emily k: updated routing to model-variant-2 for non-critical requests and sent fallback policy to route to deduped-cache path. logs: ```
# recent metric snippet
2026-03-14T20:21:06Z embed-service 200 102ms
2026-03-14T20:22:10Z embed-service 502 0ms rpc reset
2026-03-14T20:23:45Z embed-service 200 115ms
```
olivia: customer impact slate: small percentage (<1%%) of requests for large-batch embeddings failed; a few ingest pipelines retried and caused visible queueing. No revenue-impacting errors reported yet but a handful of support tickets referencing degraded embeddings.
ops-bot: Alert suppression applied: 30m window. Pager duties unaffected. Incident tracking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2029
raj p: mitigation check: reduced 5xxs from 12%% -> 1.5%% after routing changes and temporary rate cap. latency p95 back within SLO for most paths.
emily k: OK let's prepare handoff. I'm stepping off in 15m. @samuel g please take primary until we close the post-incident review.
samuel g: taking primary. notes: suspected root cause - upstream mesh flaps causing connection resets; cascade effect when cold-KV-cache leads to heavier compute and timeouts. action: add retry-with-jitter and backpressure at proxy layer.
miguel r: filing initial follow-ups in INF-2030 (short-term mitigations) and INF-2031 (long-term routing fixes). tagging owners.
emily k: customer comms: draft for CSMs: "We experienced transient 5xxs for a subset of embedding requests in us-west-2. Root cause under investigation; fallback routing mitigated impact. We're scheduling postmortem and will follow up with details and remediation timeline." any objections?
olivia: fine, please cc support@redwood and include a note about no data loss.
samuel g: quick handoff checklist:
- incident link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2029
- active mitigations: routing -> model-variant-2, proxy rate cap, cache bypass on heavy paths
- monitoring: p95 latency dashboards + 5xx counter (alert threshold 5%%)
- tentative RCA: upstream mesh instability + insufficient circuit-breaker tuning
- owners: raj p (infra tuning), miguel r (proxy changes), emily k (customer comms)
raj p: i'll schedule a cron to collect tcpdump logs from the mesh nodes during peak to reproduce. put me as owner on INF-2031.
emily k: postmortem planning — propose brown-bag + retro next Wed 10:30 PT. agenda: timeline, RCA, mitigation decisions, action-item assignment, prevention patterns.
olivia: +1 for brown-bag, would like to include SRE and Platform engs.
miguel r: add a short demo of the circuit-breaker tuning and a suggested template for proxy configs.
samuel g: assigning action items now (will create a summary in INF-2029):
- A1: add retry-with-jitter at proxy (owner: raj p, due: 2026-03-21)
- A2: add circuit-breaker and per-tenant queue limits (owner: miguel r, due: 2026-04-01)
- A3: update runbook with handoff checklist and customer comms template (owner: emily k, due: 2026-03-18)
- A4: schedule brown-bag and retro, capture slides (owner: olivia, due: 2026-03-20)
- A5: create synthetic load test for large-batch embedding paths (owner: samuel g, due: 2026-03-28)
emily k: thanks team. will put these into the ticket and ping folks in the postmortem doc.
ops-bot: Reminder: please add the timeline and relevant runbook sections to the postmortem template: https://redwood.internal/docs/postmortem-template
raj p: FYI, i found a minor config drift on the proxy side where `idle_timeout_ms` was 1000 on two nodes. will roll out consistent config and monitor.
olivia: customer follow-up plan: CSMs will be notified when INF-2029 has the RCA writeup; propose we offer a short technical note for impacted customers.
samuel g: i'm going to leave a short note for the next oncall: if things regress, flip routing back to fallback model and escalate to infra. tagging `@oncall-primary` in the runbook.
emily k: handoff done, i'm off. :wave:
samuel g: acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring for the next 2 hours and will update this thread after we complete postmortem doc.
incident-bot: Incident INF-2029 marked as "mitigated" at 2026-03-14T20:34:12Z by emily k. Severity reduced to P3. Please update postmortem within 7 days. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)
